commands.name: progress-close
commands.description: Close a node or a request of the progress board: done or dropped

commands.name: progress-line
commands.description: Put a request of the progress board in a line, or in a new line by name
commands.output: Usage: /progress-line <request id> <line id>, or /progress-line <request id> new <name>

tools.name: progress_plan
tools.description: Records the plan for the person's request on the progress board: a title, 1 to 3 checkable acceptance items and 1 to 6 steps. Call it once the plan is settled and before making changes. Call it again with request when the plan changes: the new steps join that request, and drop names its steps the new plan no longer needs. Not for questions or chat. It records the plan on the progress board and costs nothing else.
